title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes-ethan-park-2026-03-11
content:
Weekly release-train prep notes (quick personal scratchpad)

Meeting: Release Train Weekly Sync — Thu 2026-03-11 10:00 PT
Owner: Ethan Park
Attendees (expected): Maya, Olivia, Samir, Luke, Priya (ops), QA lead TBD
Purpose: quick go/no-go sanity check for the 2026-03-18 candidate launch; surface blockers, confirm owners, and align rollforward/fallback plan.

High-level status
- Candidate release date: 2026-03-18 (code freeze scheduled 2026-03-15 EOD).
- Current confidence: yellow — most infra features ready, 2 known blockers in serving runtime + one infra scaling regression under investigation.
- Key metrics to validate before go: e2e acceptance pass rate >= 98%, median p95 latency <= 220ms on prod-like load, canary error rate < 0.5% over 1h.

Top blockers (short notes + owners)
1) Serving runtime memory leak on long-lived KV cache (seen in staging nightly runs) — owner: Samir Patel. Current: repro'd locally with stress harness; mitigation: restart job every 6h as temporary workaround. Next: root-cause triage and patch ETA 2026-03-14.
2) Autoscaler mis-sizing for Dedicated pool with new model shard config (observed under spike test) — owner: Maya Singh. Current: scaling thresholds too aggressive; rolling fix merged but needs 1 full day soak on staging. Soak window planned 2026-03-12.
3) Eval regression: small accuracy drop for prompt family retail-rewrite-1 after quantization change — owner: Olivia Martin. Current: evaluation shows 1.4% delta; investigating whether prompt rewrite or revert quantization profile. Decision needed by 2026-03-13.

Pre-meeting runbook (what I want to confirm in sync)
- Quick run through checklist items (below) and call out any changes to go/no-go criteria.
- Confirm staging soak status (Maya) and whether we can extend soak if needed.
- Samir to present memory leak triage notes and proposed patch timeline. If patch misses freeze, confirm restart cadence and monitoring alerts.
- Olivia to summarize eval regression and recommended mitigation (hotfix revert vs accept).
- Priya (ops) to confirm rollout window and fallback capacity (reserve 10% Dedicated + cross-region fallback plan).
- QA: confirm acceptance test coverage for new routing policy and canary test plan.

Go/No-Go checklist (personal copy — mirror of Confluence RT checklist, condensed)
- Code freeze date defined and blocked PRs resolved or deferred (yes/no)
- All critical/priority-1 bugs fixed and verified (yes/no)
- Load tests: canary and full load pass on staging (yes/no)
- Soak: at least 24h soak on release candidate for infra changes (yes/no)
- Monitoring: dashboards created and owners assigned (yes/no)
- Rollback plan: validated rollback steps and playbook doc linked (yes/no)
- Security/compliance: any new data paths reviewed (yes/no)
- SLOs: latency and error SLOs validated under expected traffic (yes/no)
- Release engineers and on-call roster staffed for rollout window (yes/no)

Draft action items (from this week's work)
- Samir: complete memory leak patch + PR by 2026-03-13; if delayed, post back restart cadence and update monitoring alert thresholds (BLOCKER).
- Maya: finish autoscaler soak on staging 2026-03-12; send soak report by EOD 2026-03-12.
- Olivia: decide on quantization revert vs prompt fix by 2026-03-13; if revert chosen, prepare rollback PR.
- Priya: confirm Dedicated reserve capacity and cross-region fallback plan by 2026-03-14; update runbook.
- QA (assigned: Luke): expand canary acceptance tests to cover new routing policy and run one canary pass on 2026-03-14.
- Me (Ethan): update Confluence RT checklist with decision notes and produce final go/no-go recommendation doc by 2026-03-15 AM.

Notes / talking points (short)
- If memory leak patch slips past freeze, we need an approved operational mitigation that doesn't increase manual ops overhead too much. Consider shorter restart cadence + automated drain prior to restart.
- Evaluate whether we can tolerate small eval regression in a small subset of prompts if the cost/latency improvements are significant — get product signoff.
- Communicate early to customers on dedicated if we foresee a narrower launch window; avoid surprise.

Quick links (for meeting)
- Confluence runbook: CONFLUENCE-RT/launch-readiness-checklist
- Jira board: https://jira.redwood-inference.com/boards/RT
- Staging dashboard: https://grafana.redwood-inference.com/d/staging/release-train
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/922

Personal TODOs pre-meeting (today)
- Pull recent staging e2e summary and attach to Confluence (EOD).
- Ping Samir for memory leak repro logs and add a short blurb to the agenda.
- Draft go/no-go recommendation template and share with Maya/Olivia for quick review.

Tone/desired outcome: leave meeting with a clear binary recommendation (go / delay) and a small list of unavoidable follow-ups with assigned owners + firm dates. Keep communication conservative — prefer delaying if critical infra fixes are not in place.

-- end scratchpad (will tidy and move to Confluence as final if decisions made)
